summary: Guard-conditional byte-field reader. When both object pointers a1 and a2 are non-null, returns the unsigned byte at offset 29 of a2; otherwise returns 0. No side effects; used by sub_50210E as a value lookup helper.

operations.description: Guard on a1 being non-null; when null the function returns 0.
Guard on a2 being non-null; when null the function returns 0.
Read the unsigned byte at a2 + 29 as the return value.
Return the byte at a2 + 29 when both guards pass, otherwise 0.

unresolved: Identity of a1 and a2 object types is unknown; a2 is a struct whose byte at +29 holds a config-like value, a1 appears to be an enable/ownership guard.
Semantic meaning of the byte at offset 29 is not established.
